headline: Sri Lanka Accelerates Clean Energy Transition Following Oil Price Pressures
summary: Sri Lanka is moving to accelerate its transition to renewable energy sources, spurred by acute exposure to volatile international oil markets and severe balance of payments constraints.
why: Sri Lanka underwent a severe sovereign debt restructuring following foreign currency shortages driven partly by fuel import bills. Fast-tracking renewable power reduces systemic macroeconomic vulnerability to global oil price spikes.

impacts.name: Sri Lanka
impacts.why: Accelerating domestic clean energy infrastructure reduces long-term foreign exchange outflows for fossil fuel imports.
